youtube_title: Zettlr 4.8 adds admonitions: callouts in Markdown
description: Zettlr 4.8.0 (September 18, 2026) adds admonitions: note, tip, info, warning and caution callouts, written with blockquote syntax. Also in this release, full-text search now treats a space as AND, not OR. Free and open source. Source: https://www.zettlr.com/post/zettlr-480-released
ig_caption:
Zettlr 4.8 finally lets your Markdown notes shout.
Five callout types, written as > [!NOTE] — no plugin, no paid tier.
Heads up: full-text search now treats a space as AND, not OR.
